items.title: Why Bitcoin Is on Track for Its Best Stretch Since 2024
items.summary: Bitcoin has gained 14% over the past four days, its best performance over that period since 2024. The cryptocurrency hit $72,844 during Thursday's trading session, a 6.2% gain, marking its highest intraday level since June 1.
